source.test: createNewServer(..., javaPath: String? = nil) install-step java invocation

notes: The ordinary case: a create call with no explicit `javaPath` (the CLI/UI's normal path, since the parameter defaults to nil) falls through to `configManager.config.javaPath`, the same global default `AppViewModel+ServerControls.swift:121` uses for the start-time compatibility warning. This is the counterpart to the override case -- together they are the whole of 'per-server-then-global precedence' this step's What line names, since MSC 1 has no persisted per-server java path to fall back *from*.
